visa.notes: Temporary resident visa requires ~$1,500/mo income or ~$25,000 savings.

rent.notes: Rio Times Sep 2026: 3BR outside centre 1,050-1,460 USD, 3BR centre 1,750-2,630, 1BR outside centre (Ejidal/Colosio) 410-700. Mitula shows 2BR units in outer developments (Playa del Sol, Ciudad Mayakoba, Selvanova) at 11,000 MXN (about 590 USD) and a furnished 2BR in Nicte-Ha at 31,000 MXN. Typical = pet-friendly 2-3BR outside the tourist core.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of Living Playa del Carmen Expats 2026
Mitula - departamentos 2 recamaras Playa del Carmen

groceries.notes: Playa supermarket prices run above Merida (milk ~1.67 USD/L, eggs ~2.73/dozen per Rio Times Sep 2026); couple basket about 330-550 USD plus roughly 90-110 USD/mo large-breed kibble for a 100 lb dog (estimate). National food inflation near 3.6% (Oct 2026).

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of Living Playa del Carmen Expats 2026
UnoTV - Inflacion en Mexico llega a 3.62% en octubre

utilities.notes: Rio Times Sep 2026: basic utilities for an 85 m2 flat 90-139 USD/mo, 175-292 in AC months; a 3BR house on CFE penalty (DAC) tariff bills 438-700 USD every two months. Excludes internet; includes LP gas, Aguakan water and trash. Quintana Roo summer subsidy Apr-Oct as in Yucatan.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of Living Playa del Carmen Expats 2026
Diario de Yucatan - CFE termina tarifa de verano 2026 (Yucatan, Campeche, Quintana Roo)

healthcare.notes: National figures reused: IMSS family insurance 19,800 MXN/yr per person aged 60-69 (about 176 USD/mo for two at 18.75); private gastos medicos mayores at 56-65 is 80,000-140,000 MXN/yr each (710-1,245 USD/mo for two). Rio Times Playa corroborates: public cover ~100 USD/mo at 60, private 320-800 USD/mo at 60. Typical = IMSS plus a lower-cost private plan.

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (250 = health) to renters/contents only: tenant contents policies 1,500-4,000 MXN/yr (May 2026), about 7-18 USD/mo. Hurricane-zone: confirm windstorm is included in the contents policy.

petCare.notes: National pricing reused: vet visit about 480-740 MXN, Bravecto large-dog dose 899-999 MXN per 3 months; 2 visits, vaccines, flea/tick and heartworm preventives = roughly 8,000-10,000 MXN/yr (35-45 USD/mo). Riviera Maya clinics skew slightly pricier than Merida.

petDaycare.notes: Profeco large-breed boarding 250-495 MXN/night nationally; about 4 nights/month plus occasional daycare = 1,000-2,000 MXN (53-107 USD); max covers a 10-night trip month.

sources.title: TV Azteca - Cuanto cuesta dejar a un perro en una pension o guarderia

petGrooming.notes: National 2026 guide: giant long-haired dog bath 420-520 MXN, bath plus cut 480-550 MXN; one full groom per month = about 27-32 USD, max allows an extra deshedding bath in the humid season.

sources.title: Cronoshare - Cuanto cuesta un servicio de peluqueria canina (Jan 2026)

transportation.notes: One modest car: Magna about 24 MXN/L in the southeast (Profeco Sep 2026; national premium avg 28.57), 80 L/mo = about 100 USD; cobertura amplia insurance 12,500-15,800 MXN/yr (56-70 USD/mo); plus maintenance and Quintana Roo registration. Min = no car: colectivo 0.58 USD/ride, in-town taxi 3.50-8.75 USD (Rio Times Sep 2026).

entertainment.notes: Broadband 60 Mbps+ about 31 USD (Totalplay/Izzi fiber similar), ~30 USD streaming, three-course dinner for two about 47 USD roughly 4x/month, plus beach clubs, cenotes and ferry trips (Rio Times Sep 2026).
